prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” digital marketing agency in St. Louis — the right agency depends on your goals, budget, industry, and whether you need local presence or specialty services (SEO, PPC, web development, social, e‑commerce, B2B lead gen, etc.).

To help you quickly, tell me a few things:
- What are your top goals? (more sales, leads, foot traffic, brand awareness, e‑commerce revenue, etc.)
- Monthly budget range for marketing/agency fees?
- Industry (B2B, healthcare, legal, retail, franchise, startup)?
- Timeline / any must-haves (Google Partner, local office, past work in your industry)?
- Do you already have a website or internal marketing team?

If you want an immediate next step, I can:
- Give a tailored shortlist of 3–5 St. Louis agencies that fit your needs (with pros/cons and questions to ask each), or
- Give a short list of well-regarded local agencies right now plus a checklist to evaluate them.

Evaluation checklist (use these when comparing agencies)
- Relevant case studies and measurable results (traffic, leads, conversion rate, ROAS)
- Client references you can call
- Transparency on fees, reporting cadence, and KPIs
- Team experience and dedicated account contact
- Tools & certifications (Google Partner, Facebook Business, analytics/CRO tools)
- Contract terms and exit clauses
- Cultural fit and communication style

Budget ballpark (typical monthly agency retainer expectations)
- <$2k/mo: tactical, limited work (small local SEO, light social)
- $2k–5k/mo: basic SEO + PPC management or ongoing social/content
- $5k–15k/mo: full ongoing SEO, PPC, content, CRO, reporting
- $15k+/mo: enterprise-level strategy, creative, multi-channel campaigns

Tell me the details above and I’ll research and recommend the top 3–5 St. Louis agencies for your situation, with recommended next questions and an email template to request proposals.
